# OmniTools 2.0

> OmniTools is a fast, 100% client-side, privacy-first web productivity portal offering 64 free utilities across PDF conversion, image editing, financial & health calculators, SEO analysis, developer/text utilities, live currency conversion, and browser games. Every file and calculation is processed directly inside browser memory with zero server uploads, zero data retention, and zero ads.

## Privacy & Architecture Guarantees
- **100% Client-Side Execution:** Documents, images, and inputs are processed locally via HTML5 Web APIs (Canvas, FileReader, Blob, Web Speech, LocalStorage) and client-side libraries (`pdf.js`, `jsPDF`, `pdf-lib`, `JSZip`, `SheetJS/XLSX`, `Chart.js`, `CryptoJS`, `qrcodejs`).
- **Zero Server Uploads:** User files never leave the browser or touch external storage servers.
- **Zero Ads & Zero File Tracking:** Only browser-local storage (`localStorage`) is used for theme preference, tool favorites, recent tools, and the Notes App scratchpad.
- **Full Technical Index:** [llms-full.txt](https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/llms-full.txt)

## Core Portal Pages
- [OmniTools Home Hub](https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/): Searchable directory of all 64 client-side productivity tools with Ctrl+K command search, Favorites, and Recently Used shortcuts.
- [Privacy Policy](https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/privacy.html): Official privacy architecture documentation (0% server uploads, 100% local processing).
- [Contact Support](https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/contactus.html): Support channels, bug reporting, and privacy FAQ.
